interpretation.selection: Author-deposited encoding-responsive subset; no filtering by is_signif_recall.
interpretation.time: Recall spikes and mention times in ms relative to context cue; MATLAB story indices converted explicitly.
interpretation.guard: 1500<=mention<=13000 is a proposed full postcue premention window inside nominal task duration; not proof of acquisition coverage.
interpretation.missing: No per-trial correctness, participant mapping, acquisition-boundary or coverage fields. Spike extrema cannot prove coverage.
interpretation.vp: 10000 padding must be removed for future VP analyses; VP combines before and after the memory task.
interpretation.claim: Input audit only. No recall effect, CE mechanism, synaptic plasticity or metric estimate computed.
